Above them, a text overlay states "smile if you want a new girlfriend." (2) The man crosses his arms over his chest, maintaining a stern and serious facial expression while looking straight ahead. The woman begins a series of highly animated movements, throwing her arms up, making exaggerated faces, and leaning closer to the man's face. The background shows a wooden dresser filled with numerous cosmetic bottles and a round mirror hanging on the wall. The lighting is bright and consistent throughout the room. (3) The man eventually breaks into a wide smile and quickly runs out of the frame to the left side. The woman points her finger toward his direction, her mouth wide open as she makes an expressive gesture. She then turns her body and walks directly toward the camera lens, causing her hair to fill the frame. The messy bed covers and a small yellow ball on the floor are briefly visible.
